text:
nina (design): Dropping a tiny iteration idea: move schema validator out of the top banner and into an inline "function-validation" affordance on each fn in the defs list. keeps editor real estate clean and surfaces errors at glance.
leo (devex): Love that. Quick Q: should the pin live on the list row or inside the editor header? list feels lighter.
nina (design): list row. clicking opens a small inline panel under the row with short messages + link to the failing field.
harper (backend): backend ok with that. note: when opening panel we may need to re-run linter for fresh results. propose debounce 250ms and cache last result for 30s.
ravi (a11y): Accessibility: panel must be role=region with aria-label="Function validation" and errors announced with aria-live="polite". Also ensure keyboard users can open via Enter and navigate errors via Arrow keys.
leo (devex): Good call. I'll add keyboard shortcuts: Enter toggles, Shift+Enter focuses first error, Esc closes. Also add visible focus ring and aria-hidden toggling for collapsed content.
nina (design): Another parallel: compact run card for run history. Show tool name, one-line summary (first sentence of structured output), a subtle cost-chip, and a chevron. expand shows full structured output with tabs (Request / Response / Meta).
claire (product): Cost chip useful — PMs want quick visibility on expensive ops. Can we surface approximate tokens and USD? small, muted chip.
harper (backend): Implementation: only store summary + metadata for most recent N runs. full payload lazy-load on expand via pointer (internal id or S3). streaming runs need a streaming flag so UI shows a live indicator.
leo (devex): UI behaviour: compact card shows a pulsing dot when streaming, cost chip when known, and an expand animation that moves focus into the output pane. On expand we should trap focus inside until closed.
ravi (a11y): Trap focus is fine if there's a clear close control. When expanded, focus must land on first actionable element and screen reader should announce "Tool output expanded".
harper (backend): Data contract proposal: summaryText, pointerId, costApprox, isStreaming, timestamp. I'll draft RFC. storage note: keep summaries <= 256 chars.
leo (devex): UX copy tweak: replace ambiguous "Args" label with "Call arguments" and "Result" with "Tool result" for clarity.
nina (design): Copy accepted. small CSS note: cost chip 11px, rounded, #F3F4F6 bg and 600 weight for number.
claire (product): Rollout plan: beta 10% of org, track expand rate and avg cost per run. metric threshold: if avg cost delta > 10% revert.
ui-deploy-bot: nina pushed playground preview: https://preview.redwood/playground/compact-runcard (preview env available)
leo (devex): Action list: 1) harper write RFC + pointer contract, 2) harper implement debounce + pointer, 3) ravi produce accessibility checklist, 4) nina final copy + visuals, 5) claire set experiment in metrics.
nina (design): thanks everyone! I'll upload the final frames and the copy file shortly. :sparkles:
